description:
TRUSTMH-BENCH: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Evaluating the Trustworthiness of LLMs in Mental Health
	

Official repository for TRUSTMH-BENCH, a specialized benchmark designed to evaluate the trustworthiness of Large Language Models (LLMs) in mental health settings.

	
		
		🌟 Overview
	

TrustMH-Bench is a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating both general-purpose and mental-health-specific LLMs. It evaluates models across eight critical dimensions: Reliability, Crisis Identification… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/qiyuan666/TrustMH_Bench_dataset.
evaluation_method: human_eval (rubric-based) and automated classification metrics where applicable
reputation: Specialized benchmark for LLM trustworthiness in mental-health contexts; relatively new and primarily used in safety/medical-ML research.
